meta.rule: No expectation below may be edited after observing a result. Corrections must be appended to corrections[] with a date and reason.

corrections.change: Fixture is 4 GSTR-2B rows and 4 purchase rows: 2 matched-eligible, 1 amount-mismatch, 1 in-2b-only, 1 in-books-only (5 reconciled invoices).
corrections.reason: Recorded BEFORE the fixture or the check was first run: the original line described a 4+4 fixture whose counts did not correspond to any concrete row set. The corrected counts pin the exact fixture now used, which is embedded verbatim in qa-report/ui/checks/itc-oracle.mjs and in the in-page example.

corrections.change: Independent oracle asserts counts, per-invoice verdicts, Table 4(C)=4(A)-4(B) per head, and that the books-only invoice's tax never enters 4(A).
corrections.reason: Recorded BEFORE the check first ran. Also recorded: the end-to-end part of C20 covers the API and the delivered page's rendering of the same figures; it is separate from the browser check run, which is recorded as C20b with the same expectation.

checks.title: Exactly one sidebar navigation landmark
checks.expected: count(nav[aria-label='Primary'] inside aside) == 1 at 1440 and 768; mobile drawer adds exactly one while open and zero after close
checks.before_expected: FAIL: desktop aside is not hidden below lg, so the drawer mounts a second Primary nav on top of it (D1)

checks.title: Zero duplicate visible sidebar labels
checks.expected: For every sidebar item label, occurrences among visible sidebar label nodes == 1 at 1440, 768, 390 (expanded and collapsed)
checks.before_expected: FAIL: each item renders a <summary> label row plus an <a> label row (D1)

checks.title: Sidebar widths and collapse persistence
checks.expected: expanded offsetWidth 256px +/- 1; collapsed 72px +/- 1; state survives reload via localStorage; empty storage renders expanded with no exception
checks.before_expected: FAIL: fixed w-64 with no collapsed state; no persistence; 240px content padding mismatches 256px sidebar

checks.title: No sidebar or page horizontal overflow
checks.expected: sidebar.scrollWidth <= sidebar.clientWidth and documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth at 1440, 768, 390, 320
checks.before_expected: FAIL: long labels ('Presentations', 'Business Advisor') exceed the 256px rail and the page overlaps (D3)

checks.title: No overlapping bounding boxes in the shell
checks.expected: Pairwise intersection area == 0 among sidebar items, header controls, header search, and sidebar search region at 1440, 768, 390
checks.before_expected: FAIL: the second sidebar search box is absolutely positioned over the nav; sidebar (256px) and main padding (240px) overlap (D2)

checks.title: Grouped navigation with real section headings
checks.expected: Sidebar renders >= 4 visible uppercase group headings; every heading names a group that contains at least one existing route; no invented group
checks.before_expected: FAIL: flat list, one undifferentiated nav, no group headings

checks.title: Collapsed state is icons-only with accessible names
checks.expected: In collapsed state every nav row shows exactly one 20px icon, no visible label text, and every control has an accessible name; hover/focus shows a tooltip
checks.before_expected: FAIL: no collapsed state exists

checks.title: Mobile drawer behavior
checks.expected: At 390px: hamburger opens drawer with overlay; Tab cycles inside drawer; Escape closes; selecting a route closes; background is inert; aria-expanded reflects state
checks.before_expected: FAIL: drawer is `lg:hidden`, the desktop aside stays visible underneath, no focus trap (D1/D6)

checks.title: One global search and complete header controls
checks.expected: Header contains exactly one search control (opens Cmd/Ctrl+K command palette), one notifications link, one language control, one profile menu; no search input inside the sidebar
checks.before_expected: FAIL: sidebar search duplicates the header search; no profile menu on desktop; language control renders a native select (D2)

checks.title: Language switcher is honest
checks.expected: Default locale is English (html lang='en'); any non-English option is labelled as partial coverage; choosing it changes translated strings and persists across reload; no option is present that has zero translated strings
checks.before_expected: FAIL: DEFAULT_LOCALE='hi' while all page copy is English (D4)

checks.title: WCAG AA contrast in the active theme
checks.expected: All sidebar/header text >= 4.5:1 against its background; active indicator and focus ring >= 3:1
checks.before_expected: UNKNOWN: measured in BEFORE; text-muted on surface expected near threshold

checks.title: Keyboard path and ARIA state
checks.expected: Tab reaches brand, nav items, collapse toggle, header controls in DOM order; a visible focus ring is computed for each; active item has aria-current='page'; group toggles have aria-expanded
checks.before_expected: FAIL: nav uses summary/a with no keyboard contract; aria-current only on the duplicate anchor

checks.title: Every nav link is live and renders content
checks.expected: Every href in the rendered nav returns HTTP 200 at 1440/768/390 (authenticated) and main#main-content has > 100 characters of text; zero 404 or blank
checks.before_expected: FAIL: nav contains /settings?tab=deliverables and similar which may 200; /ca-sources is present but below an unscrollable fold (D5/D6)

checks.title: Zero console errors and zero hydration warnings
checks.expected: On load and after each interaction: 0 console errors, 0 'Hydration failed'/'did not match' warnings, 0 pageerrors
checks.before_expected: UNKNOWN: recorded in BEFORE; any error must be explained before it is called fixed

checks.title: No failed network requests
